maria: heads up — noticed a 2.3x latency spike on long-prefill replay for a customer workload. timeline + repro attached? :grimacing:
aj: ugh, when did this start? CI graphs?
maria: started ~ yesterday after 1762 runtime rollout. Bench run: `replay_harness --trace --long-context --seed 42`. see snippet:
```
# run
./bench/replay_harness --model redwood-3b-q4 --input workload_long.prefill.json --prefill-first --workers 8
```
maria: sample p95 decode went from ~180ms -> ~420ms on prefill-dominant flows.
kai: any kernel-change in kernel selector? we shipped a heuristic that prefers fused-attn for prefill vs causal-scan for decode.
sasha: yes, kernel selector 1762 toggles fused->scan fallback when kv-hit < 0.6. maybe miscomputing kv-hit for replay?
aj: can you dump profiler traces?
perf-bot: uploaded /artifacts/1792045678/profiler.zip
maria: profiler shows hot time inside `kv_cache_read()` during prefill, lots of random-access misses. batch sizes small (~2) but prefill chunks huge (8k tokens).
kai: hmm, batching heuristic assumes prefill is amortized — but with tiny concurrent qps it disables continuous-batching. that plus fused kernel being heavier on memory could flip perf.
sasha: Is this apples-to-apples? replay harness used original client timestamps; synthetic longmix didn't show regression.
maria: correct — synthetic generator had aggregated prefix caching while replay preserves unique prefixes, so cache hit ratio diverges.
aj: plan: 1) add kv-hit metric to runtime logs, 2) force kernel selector to probe alternatives on first N requests, 3) run apples-to-apples: same seed & reorder in synthetic to mimic replay.
kai: quick test: `RT_KV_DEBUG=1 ./runtime --exp-kernel-probe=3` showed fallback to scan improved p95 by ~40% in repro.
maria: but scan increases GPU kernel time on decode; need dynamic policy: if prefill dominates (>70% tokens prefill) prefer memory-friendly kernels.
sasha: Agreed. Also add a microbenchmark that isolates kv read bandwidth: `bench/kv_micro --seqlen 8192 --concurrency 1`. gist: https://gist.company/kv-micro-8192
aj: can we turn on prefix caching for replay harness to make more comparable? or better: have synthetic generate diverse prefixes.
maria: filed PERF-498 in board. steps in PR: runtime: expose avg_kv_hit, probe policy, add prefill-aware kernel weight. bench: new replay config `--simulate-unique-prefixes`.
sasha: can someone run a 6h soak on dedicated with model redwood-3b-q4, seqlen mix [2048,4096,8192], prefill_ratio 0.8? I'll schedule.
bench-bot: soak job queued (#6739) — ETA 2h
aj: thanks. also adding an eval that compares apples-to-apples token stats and p95s across kernels.
maria: thanks all. small followups: logs to include kernel_choice per request, and a lightweight kv-hit tracer in the console dashboard.
kai: noted. I'll open runtime PR today.
maria: closing loop — if anyone has immediate repros drop them here or attach logs.
